title: File:Cleavage failure in pipeline steel (7251418220).jpg
art: National Institute of Standards and Technology
desc:
Scanning electron microscope images of a test section of X100 alloy pipeline steel shows the effects of a hydrogen-induced crack at the surface. Image shows an area roughly 21.5 micrometers across. Color added for clarity.
